newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said it reiterated its buy rating on Brazilian state-owned telecom firm Telebras.
-- "We reiterate our buy recommendation on Telebras with a mid-1997 price target of $95/ADS as the company appears well on its way to meeting our $80/ADS full-year 1996 earnings forecast," it said.
-- On Wednesday, Telebras announced it had a net consolidated profit of 1.980 billion reais between January and September. Its holding company reported a net profit of 2.389 billion reais.
